items.title: I made an AI tool that applies to jobs via cold email
items.raw_excerpt:
I made an AI tool that applies to jobs via cold email because LinkedIn Easy Apply was getting me nowhere. Most applications just disappear into ATS filters, so I wanted something that sends a personalised application directly to the company or HR. The tool extracts information from your resume, matches it with the job description, writes a personalised email in your style, and either finds the company email automatically or lets you set your own. It then sends the email with your CV attached through your own personal email account. There are two modes:
Rapid Mode uses LinkedIn search results, and CSV Mode lets you upload a list of jobs and apply to all of them in one go. I originally built it for myself, but decided to share it in case it helps anyone else dealing with the same frustration

items.title: 机构：10月全球半导体销售额同比激增33%，总额达713亿美元
items.raw_excerpt: 据美国半导体行业协会（SIA）的最新数据，10月全球半导体销售额同比激增33%，总额达713亿美元（约合人民币5040亿元），其中DRAM（动态随机存取存储器）销售额同比飙升90%。分析认为，这背后的最大助推力是，人工智能（AI）推动需求激增，大量行业产能转向用于AI加速器的高带宽内存（HBM），导致用于标准DRAM和3D NAND的晶圆产出减少。当前全球AI基础设施建设热潮正在造成存储芯片等关键投入品短缺，或将推动2026年DRAM均价持续上涨。Counterpoint Research预计，先进和传统存储芯片价格将在2026年初可能再涨20%。

title_i18n.zh: 机构：10月全球半导体销售额同比激增33%，总额达713亿美元
title_i18n.en: Institution: Global semiconductor sales surged 33% year-on-year in October, reaching a total of $71.3 billion.
title_i18n.es: Instituciones: En octubre, las ventas globales de semiconductores aumentaron un 33% interanual, alcanzando un total de 71.300 millones de dólares.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 据美国半导体行业协会（SIA）的最新数据，10月全球半导体销售额同比激增33%，总额达713亿美元（约合人民币5040亿元），其中DRAM（动态随机存取存储器）销售额同比飙升90%。分析认为，这背后的最大助推力是，人工智能（AI）推动需求激增，大量行业产能转向用于AI加速器的高带宽内存（HBM），导致用于标准DRAM和3D NAND的晶圆产出减少。当前全球AI基础设施建设热潮正在造成存储芯片等关键投入品短缺，或将推动2026年DRAM均价持续上涨。Counterpoint Research预计，先进和传统存储芯片价格将在2026年初可能再涨20%。
excerpt_i18n.en: According to the latest data from the Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) of the United States, global semiconductor sales surged 33% year-on-year in October, reaching a total of $71.3 billion (approximately 504 billion yuan), with DRAM (Dynamic Random Access Memory) sales soaring 90% year-on-year. Analysis suggests that the primary driving force behind this is the surge in demand driven by artificial intelligence (AI), as significant industry capacity shifts toward high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI accelerators, leading to reduced wafer output for standard DRAM and 3D NAND. The current global AI infrastructure construction boom is causing shortages of key inputs such as memory chips, which may drive a sustained increase in the average price of DRAM through 2026. Counterpoint Research predicts that prices for advanced and traditional memory chips could rise by an additional 20% in early 2026.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según los últimos datos de la Asociación de la Industria de Semiconductores de Estados Unidos (SIA), en octubre las ventas globales de semiconductores aumentaron un 33% interanual, alcanzando un total de 71.300 millones de dólares (aproximadamente 504.000 millones de yuanes), con las ventas de DRAM (memoria de acceso aleatorio dinámico) disparándose un 90% en comparación con el año anterior. Los análisis señalan que el principal impulsor detrás de esto es el auge de la demanda impulsado por la inteligencia artificial (IA), que ha llevado a que gran parte de la capacidad de producción de la industria se redirija hacia la memoria de alto ancho de banda (HBM) utilizada en aceleradores de IA, reduciendo así la producción de obleas para DRAM estándar y 3D NAND. La actual fiebre de construcción de infraestructura de IA a nivel global está provocando escasez de insumos clave como los chips de memoria, lo que podría impulsar el precio promedio del DRAM en 2026.

items.title: What do you usually do while waiting for AI responses?
items.raw_excerpt:
I've noticed that when using various AI tools, there's often a short pause—sometimes a few seconds, sometimes longer, especially AI coding case—before the model returns an answer. It's an awkward amount of time: too short to switch tasks, but long enough to break your flow. I'm curious: - What do you typically do while waiting for an AI response?
(Do you zone out? Check email? Scroll HN? Or not think about it at all?) - What would you like to be able to do during that time?
(Quick actions? Useful hints? Better progress indicators? Something else?) - Have you seen any products that handle this waiting experience particularly well—or poorly? Thanks!

items.title: Watsn.ai – Scarily accurate lie detector
items.raw_excerpt: No signup required—just upload or record a video to verify its truthfulness. You can test it on anyone: internet clips, your significant other, or even yourself. I'm aware there are tons of scammy 'lie detector' apps out there, but I built this using SOTA multimodal models in hopes of creating a genuine breakthrough in the space. It analyzes micro-expressions, voice patterns, and context. In my own testing (over 50 trials), it reached about 85% accuracy, which honestly felt a bit scary. It’s also fun to test on famous YouTube clips (like Obama talking about UFOs). I’d love to hear what you think and will be improving Watsn.ai every day based on your feedback!

excerpt_i18n.en: Amid the global intelligent revolution accelerating into the "Agent Era," enterprise intelligent platform OpenCSG has partnered with Dell Technologies to launch a reference architecture solution deeply integrated with intelligent computing infrastructure. By combining OpenCSG's AgenticOps methodology and AgenticHub platform capabilities with Dell Pro Max with GB10 high-performance computing nodes and PowerScale intelligent storage systems, the collaboration offers enterprises a low-threshold, high-efficiency, and high-performance path to intelligent transformation. This solution enables organizations to smoothly transition from traditional IT architectures to intelligent-native architectures, bringing intelligent agents directly into business operations. CSGHub: A Unified Enterprise Intelligent Hub for Computing Power and Data As OpenCSG's enterprise intelligent hub platform, CSGHub integrates computing power and PowerScale intelligent storage into a unified engineering workflow—standardizing and visually managing the entire process from data collection, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment to subsequent monitoring, rollback, and retraining. Enterprises can not only centrally manage model and data assets but also accumulate reusable R&D and agent practices across multiple projects and teams. Notably, Dell Pro Max with GB10 incorporates the data center-level Grace Blackwell architecture.
excerpt_i18n.es: En el contexto de la aceleración de la revolución inteligente global hacia la "era de los agentes inteligentes", la plataforma empresarial de inteligencia OpenCSG, en colaboración con Dell Technologies, ha lanzado una arquitectura de referencia con integración profunda en infraestructura de computación inteligente. Ambas partes combinarán la metodología AgenticOps y las capacidades de la plataforma AgenticHub de OpenCSG, junto con los nodos de computación de alto rendimiento Dell Pro Max con GB10 y el sistema de almacenamiento inteligente PowerScale, para ofrecer a las empresas un camino de transformación inteligente de bajo umbral, alta rentabilidad y alto rendimiento. A través de esta solución, las organizaciones pueden realizar una transición fluida desde arquitecturas de información tradicionales.
